narrative.northStar: An inspectable, approachable local research workbench
narrative.overview: Conversation leads. Graphite keeps long reading sessions calm; cobalt identifies actions and selection. The interface displays only states supported by the backend.
keyCharacteristics: Evidence and steps are one interaction away.
Cobalt for actions, cyan for citations, green for verified results.
Friendly labels with exact model IDs in secondary text.

rules.name: Truthful status
rules.body: Configured, installed, reachable and reviewed are separate states. Never infer one from another.

rules.name: Reading first
rules.body: Use Newsreader for answers and evidence, Geist for controls and labels.

rules.name: Cobalt action
rules.body: Use cobalt for actions and selection; reserve cyan for citations.

dos: Do keep conversation as the dominant workspace and cap explanatory prose near 75ch.
Do derive every capability and readiness signal from the backend response.
Do pair status color with a label, icon, or both.
donts: Do not show decorative gradients or fake metrics.
Do not label a configured model as reachable without a probe.
Do not hide source access or tool traces.
